root.title: Precision bench vise
root.description: Original procedural geometry and authored screw-to-jaw motion created for the Annora Explorer template.

source.author: Annora
source.description: Original procedural geometry and authored screw-to-jaw motion created for the Annora Explorer template.
source.note: Illustrative rigid-body kinematics. Not manufacturer CAD, a force simulation, or manufacturing guidance. Display finishes and separation offsets are explanatory.

groups.title: Base and mounting
groups.description: The fixed foundation and four mounting ears.

groups.title: Fixed jaw
groups.description: A fixed support and replaceable steel contact plate.

groups.title: Moving jaw
groups.description: The carriage translates along the guideways without rotating.

groups.title: Lead screw and nut
groups.description: A rotating, translating spindle passes through a stationary nut. The thread is illustrative.

groups.title: Handle
groups.description: The tommy bar rotates with the spindle and travels with the moving jaw.

groups.title: Guideways
groups.description: Two fixed steel ways align the translating carriage.

stages.title: Open position
stages.description: The jaw starts open. The base, nut and guideways remain fixed.

stages.title: Closing travel
stages.description: The handle and spindle turn together while the moving jaw translates.

stages.title: Closed position
stages.description: The authored motion pauses before reversal; no clamping force is calculated.

stages.title: Opening travel
stages.description: Reversing the spindle returns the jaw along the same guideways.

stages.title: Return to start
stages.description: The source assembly returns to its exact starting pose.
